The key derivation involves defining a functional equivalence operator F such that F(B_imp, B_exp) preserves environmental impact. The failure mode arises when neuro-muscular specificity is incorrectly prioritized over functional relevance, leading to misinterpretation of behavioral intent. The dual nature implies that both types of behavior contribute to a unified behavioral kernel, enabling robust inference in GSI and adaptive reasoning in GSE.
